summary: thedata ships an opaque OpenSSL-encrypted blob as its sole export with no decrypt or use path
details: The package's main entry (index.js) re-exports a single symbol `desKey` from apps/docs/app/theta.js, which is nothing more than `readFileSync('./des.db', 'utf8')`. The file des.db is a ~48 KB base64 string starting with `U2FsdGVkX1` (the OpenSSL `Salted__` header), i.e. an AES/DES ciphertext. The package contains no decryption routine, no network I/O, no eval or dynamic code execution, no shell invocation, and no install lifecycle hooks. Installing or importing this package does not, by itself, execute any code beyond reading a file into memory. The package name resembles a known market-data product ("Theta Data") and the shipped payload has no documented purpose within the tarball.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
